description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. 

 With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

 Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

 Software Engineer - Vehicle Test 

 We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our rapidly-growing team and improve our hardware testing capabilities. In this role, you will design the end-to-end software architecture used to validate hardware at the integrated vehicle levels as well as supporting our major HITL testbed infrastructure for flight validation, ensuring our aerospace systems are mission-ready. Your testing and infrastructure will be the ultimate safeguard ensuring our hardware and software are flight-ready.

 Your responsibilities include refining specifications from electrical engineers to validate critical flight components, supporting all development phases from proposal to final test, implementing ground control and telemetry software, and contributing to the team’s growth through active recruitment and hiring efforts.

 This role puts you at the front of the line for new hardware releases, where you will work directly in the lab to identify and fix complex issues in real-time. Because your work supports testing across all vehicle subsystems, you will gain unique insight into the entire hardware lifecycle and partner with nearly every engineering team to ensure our systems perform flawlessly under the most demanding conditions. By combining high-level architecture with hands-on validation, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that what we send into flight stays there.

 This role supports both commercial and U.S. Government programs.

 Role 

 
 Design high-level software architecture in support of vehicle integration and test operations

 Coordinate across multiple teams to create software testing infrastructure based on testing and production needs

 Work with ground software and flight software teams to integrate flight software into test infrastructure

 Design scalable test code to be reused across multiple different testing campaigns and vehicle generations

 Refine specifications from electrical engineers to validate critical flight components

 Support all phases of development from initial proposal development through successful test and flight 

 Help guide large test campaigns by creating the tools necessary for its success and delegating and mentoring more junior Engineers

 Assist in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring additional teammates to our rapidly-growing team

 Participate on a rotating on-call shift to troubleshoot and resolve flight and production issues

 
 Requirements 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering (or equivalent background knowledge)

 3+ years total of relevant professional experience

 Strong proficiency in Python (or other high-level object oriented scripting language(s))

 Experience designing software systems and test architectures/tooling/frameworks

 Experience with Linux and shell command line tools

 A passion for building things, including working in a fast-paced environment and hands-on design and development

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 
 Bonus 

 
 Experience working with relational or time series databases 

 Embedded systems experience

 Experience mentoring junior engineers

 What we offer:  

  

 All our positions offer a compensation package that includes equity and robust benefits.

  

 
 Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.



 Astranis pay ranges are informed and defined through professional-grade salary surveys and compensation data sources. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, and the level and scope of the position.

 Base Salary
 $130,000 — $175,000 USD 


 U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required 

 (To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

  

 Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

 Astranis SMS Terms of Service 

 
 
 Recruiting Updates: By opting in, you agree to receive SMS updates, interview coordination, and recruiting communications from Astranis Space Technologies Corp. 



 
 Opt-Out: You can cancel this service at any time by replying STOP . We will send one final text confirming your unsubscription. 



 
 Opt-In Again: To resume receiving messages, reply START or YES . 



 
 Support & Rates: For assistance, reply HELP or contact us at coordinators@astranis.com. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies; carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. 



 
 Privacy: For details on how we protect your data, view our Privacy Policy .
